service.method: SELECT USMT.USER_ID , USMT.USER_NAME_LOC , DEPT.DEPT_NAME_LOC , GETCODETEXT('000','UX049', USMT.POSITION, ${session.LANGUAGE}) AS "POSITION" , USMT.HOUSE_CODE FROM SUSMT USMT LEFT JOIN SDEPT DEPT ON USMT.DEPT = DEPT.DEPT AND USMT.HOUSE_CODE = DEPT.HOUSE_CODE WHERE 1=1 AND (USMT.USER_ID LIKE '%' || UPPER($S{F_KEYWORD}) || '%' OR USMT.USER_NAME_LOC LIKE '%' || $S{F_KEYWORD} || '%' OR DEPT.DEPT_NAME_LOC LIKE '%' || $S{F_KEYWORD} || '%' OR GETCODETEXT('000','UX049', USMT.POSITION, '#session.LANGUAGE#') LIKE '%' || $S{F_KEYWORD} || '%')
SELECT USER_ID , HOUSE_CODE FROM SUSMT WHERE USER_ID = UPPER(${USER_ID}) AND HOUSE_CODE = ${HOUSE_CODE}

SELECT USMT.USER_ID , USMT.USER_NAME_LOC , USMT.USER_NAME_ENG , USMT.EMAIL , USMT.COUNTRY , USMT.DATE_FORMAT , USMT.DEPT , USMT.POSITION , USMT.HOUSE_CODE , USMT.EMAIL , ADDR.PHONE_NO1 , ADDR.PHONE_NO2 , ADDR.ZIP_CODE , ADDR.ADDRESS_LOC FROM SUSMT USMT LEFT JOIN SADDR ADDR ON USMT.USER_ID = ADDR.CODE_NO AND USMT.HOUSE_CODE = ADDR.HOUSE_CODE WHERE USMT.HOUSE_CODE = ${ HOUSE_CODE } AND USMT.USER_ID = ${ USER_ID }
